headline: Tencent's HY4 hits 16.1% — day 2 of dominance
summary: Tencent/hy4-preview-20260827 just claimed the all-time token-share record at 16.1%, extending its streak atop the rankings. OpenAI took a 7.6-point hit overnight, while Google's brand-new gemini-3.8-flash debuted at rank 17 with a 26-spot jump. Three models dropped out entirely; meta and Moonshot AI each added fresh entries to the leaderboard.
highlights: Tencent/hy4-preview-20260827 at 16.1% token share (day 2 of all-time high)
OpenAI fell 7.6 points in one day, now at 11.4% across its portfolio
Google/gemini-3.8-flash-20260902 debuts at rank 17, up 26 spots in 24 hours
Tencent provider share jumped to 20.2% (+4.0 points); DeepSeek holds 17.2%
